title: China-to-Micronesia Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC and Harmonics — 60 Hz FSM Grid, IEEE / UL Direction, and Project Evidence
rows.target_requirement: For FSM PV projects, EMC and power-quality evidence should be prepared for a 60 Hz, 120/240 V context and for interconnection documents required by the relevant state utility and DRD filing. IEEE 1547 and UL 1741-style inverter evidence may be requested because FSM follows a US-aligned island-grid model. IEC 62920 and IEC 61000-series EMC evidence can still be useful as technical support, but exporters should not assume a 50 Hz China GB/T 37408 EMC package or EN 50549/VDE grid evidence is sufficient without FSM project review.
target_standards: IEEE 1547 — Standard for Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources with Associated Electric Power Systems Interfaces
UL 1741 — Inverters, Converters, Controllers and Interconnection System Equipment for Use With Distributed Energy Resources
IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — EMC and harmonic test methods and limits
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC files commonly rely on GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, and CNAS test reports under Chinese domestic conditions. These documents may cover China domestic 220/380 V, 50 Hz behavior but do not automatically prove compliance on FSM 120/240 V 60 Hz operation with US-aligned IEEE/UL expectations.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范
CNAS-accredited China domestic EMC and power-quality test reports
rows.gap: Gap: determine whether the inverter will be deployed as split-phase 120/240 V, three-phase 60 Hz, or transformer-coupled architecture, then map EMC and harmonic evidence to the exact FSM configuration and state utility process. Chinese EMC evidence should be screened for this 60 Hz hardware context and re-tested where required by the project utility or owner. EN 50549 or EU-style artifacts are not FSM substitutes.

mandatory_status.target: Project-dependent but commonly required by state utility and project-owner acceptance in FSM, especially where IEEE 1547, UL 1741, and harmonic limits are specified
mandatory_status.cn: China CNAS test reports are domestic evidence and are not automatically accepted for FSM utility acceptance

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not treat a China 50 Hz GB/T 37408 EMC package as complete FSM evidence. Confirm the exact FSM operating mode and utility-requested standard set, then provide IEC 62920/IEC 61000, IEEE 1547 and UL 1741 evidence as required before project submission.

source.publisher: Department of Resources and Development (DRD), Federated States of Micronesia

rows.requirement: FSM State-Utility Grid Interconnection — 120/240 V, 60 Hz NEMA-System Revalidation
rows.target_requirement: Solar PV inverters connected in FSM should be configured for a US-aligned low-voltage grid, commonly 120/240 V at 60 Hz, and must pass state utility interconnection review. Because the target market is 60 Hz, inverter evidence is typically requested against IEEE 1547 and UL 1741 expectations for anti-islanding, voltage/frequency behavior, and grid-support functions. EN 50549 or EU-style evidence is not the baseline in FSM unless the project owner explicitly requires it.
target_standards: Pohnpei Utilities Corporation — utility interconnection technical requirements for customer projects
Chuuk Public Utility Corporation — utility interconnection technical requirements for customer projects
IEEE 1547 — Standard for Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources with Associated Electric Power Systems Interfaces
UL 1741 — Inverters, Converters, Controllers and Interconnection System Equipment for Use With Distributed Energy Resources
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese grid-connection requirements for inverters are commonly documented through GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, and GB/T 19964-2024, developed for China’s 50 Hz / 220-380 V conditions. FSM requires explicit reconfiguration and acceptance for 120/240 V, 60 Hz operation.

NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定
rows.gap: Critical gap: dual mismatch — frequency and voltage differ. China 50 Hz / 220–380 V evidence does not prove FSM 60 Hz interconnection compatibility. Exporters should verify per target state utility whether anti-islanding, ride-through, reconnection, and protective relay settings must be rebuilt for 60 Hz and 120/240 V and whether inverter firmware is split-phase compatible.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for FSM grid-connection projects; project-specific interconnection evidence is required by state utility and DRD filing
mandatory_status.cn: China domestic grid-connection evidence is not directly transferable

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Validate FSM BESS-style operation as a 60 Hz state-utility interconnection process. Revalidate Chinese GB/T evidence against 120/240 V 60 Hz requirements before any submission, and confirm anti-islanding and protection settings with DRD and the receiving state utility.

rows.requirement: Regulatory and Project-Gate Review — DRD Context, State Utilities, and Island Conditions
rows.target_requirement: FSM electricity-sector oversight is shaped through the Department of Resources and Development and state utility companies rather than a single central regulator. Project acceptance therefore may include utility interconnection, local electrical inspection practices, DRD filing, insurer or financier requirements, and hurricane-aware installation expectations. Since this is a state-governed market, requirements can differ between Pohnpei and Chuuk project jurisdictions.
target_standards: Department of Resources and Development (DRD) — national energy and infrastructure policy coordination
Pohnpei Utilities Corporation — state utility interconnection requirements
Chuuk Public Utility Corporation — state utility interconnection requirements
Project-owner, insurer, and local authority requirements for FSM island installation resilience
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic PV inverter packages are often centered on factory and CNAS tests, CQC/CGC pathways, and China grid-code compatibility. These are not sufficient for FSM state utility project gates that are influenced by DRD filing and US-aligned project resilience practice.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范
CQC/CGC voluntary certification schemes for China PV inverter products
rows.gap: Gap: Chinese documentation should be supplemented with an FSM project file that identifies DRD filing route, target state utility interconnection requirements, local inspection checkpoints, 60 Hz settings, NEMA-compatible installation details, and hurricane/coastal environmental suitability. Do not rely on a China domestic certificate package as the sole project approval file.

mandatory_status.target: Project-dependent but mandatory where state utility, DRD filing, inspector, owner, financier, or insurer acceptance is required before energisation
mandatory_status.cn: China domestic certificate packages are not FSM approval substitutes

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Build an FSM-specific project file: DRD filing reference, state utility interconnection route, local inspection expectation, and 60 Hz technical controls. Chinese domestic certificates are project-supporting materials only.

rows.requirement: PV Inverter Electrical Safety — IEC 62109 Baseline, UL 1741 Expectations, and NEMA Installation Fit
rows.target_requirement: For FSM PV projects, IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 remain useful electrical-safety references. Because FSM operates in a US-aligned 120/240 V 60 Hz environment, project owners and state utilities may additionally require UL 1741 inverter evidence, NEMA-compatible installation details, and field documentation for wiring, grounding, disconnecting, surge protection, and enclosures. Tropical coastal deployments should also verify salt, humidity, and typhoon-exposure suitability.
target_standards: IEC 62109-1 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 1: General requirements
IEC 62109-2 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters
UL 1741 — Inverters, Converters, Controllers and Interconnection System Equipment for Use With Distributed Energy Resources
NEMA-style installation ecosystem — enclosure, wiring, disconnect, and field-installation compatibility as specified by the project reviewer
rows.china_equivalent: China PV inverter safety and construction files rely on GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, manufacturer declarations, and CNAS test reports. These documents support Chinese-market readiness but are not automatic evidence for FSM state-utility acceptance under a US-aligned 60 Hz model.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CQC/CGC voluntary certification schemes and CNAS laboratory reports for China domestic PV inverter products
rows.gap: Exporters should supplement Chinese files with a FSM project package. At minimum, confirm IEC 62109-1/-2 model-family coverage, 60 Hz nameplate and firmware configuration, NEMA-compatible wiring and enclosure details, grounding and disconnect instructions, surge coordination, and coastal environmental ratings. If the state utility or project reviewer requires UL 1741, Chinese GB/T evidence cannot substitute.

mandatory_status.target: Project-dependent but commonly mandatory through state utility, inspector, owner, insurer, or procurement requirements; UL 1741 is assessed per FSM project if requested
mandatory_status.cn: China domestic evidence remains supportive and is not accepted as complete FSM acceptance in itself

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Use IEC 62109-1/-2 as the baseline safety file, then confirm whether UL 1741 and NEMA-style installation evidence is required for the specific FSM project and state utility. Chinese GB/T 37408/NB/T 32004 evidence should be supporting only unless explicitly accepted by the project approval route.
